title: Migrate an authored Azure Linux base-image selection
goal: Migrate an authored Linux runtime image while checking the selected OS, native dependencies and globalization on the actual application.

selectionNotes: Only target11 is advertised; the actual .NET10 comparison adds no ninth foundation. Existing recipe/edition identities and PIN-959/PIN-963/Human gates are preserved.
Azure Linux4 remains Beta under the reviewed official source. Exact RC2 execution is not actual-GA qualification.
Managed framework-dependent runtime variant only. NativeAOT, ARM64, other variants and performance are unqualified.
The missing-native control selects libquay_missing.so; it does not uninstall the base image library. Actual zlib export/call and non-invariant fr-FR formatting are checked.
